note: No USDA record. Estimated from French/Vienna crusty white bread (fdc 172675, includes sourdough), the closest match to the crusty sourdough-style Maltese loaf. Not exact; bakery recipes vary, so weigh slices.

Plain ring-shaped bread ftira only, made from the ħobż dough; estimated from French/Vienna bread (fdc 172675). Filled ftira and Gozitan baked ftira (ftira Għawdxija) are separate concepts and need recipes.
Maltese water biscuits; formulation is brand-specific. The USDA US water biscuit record is a different product. Use the pack label.
Dip of dried broad beans (ful ta' Ġirba) with garlic, olive oil, chilli and herbs. Build from ingredients; the olive oil amount drives energy.
Maltese concentrated tomato paste; concentration, salt and sugar vary by brand. Use the jar label rather than the generic US tomato paste.
Fresh ġbejna (sheep or mixed-milk cheeselet). USDA has no comparable fresh sheep's milk curd cheese. Use a packaged ġbejna label.
Dried ġbejna; moisture and salt depend on the maker and drying time. Use the label.
Peppered dried ġbejna (tal-bżar), sometimes kept in oil or vinegar. Use the label.
Maltese pork sausage with coriander, pepper and salt; fat and salt vary by maker and USDA sausages are not equivalent. Use the label.
Flaky laminated pastry with ricotta filling. Build from ingredients (flour, fat, ricotta, egg).
Flaky laminated pastry with mushy pea filling (peas, onion, curry or spices). Build from ingredients.
Shortcrust pastry case with ricotta filling. Build from ingredients.
Shortcrust pastry case with pea filling. Build from ingredients.
Shortcrust pastry case with spinach filling (often with anchovies or tuna and olives). Build from ingredients.
Deep-fried date-filled pastry; frying oil uptake matters. Build from ingredients.
Pastry rings filled with black treacle, sugar, semolina, spices and citrus peel. Build from ingredients.
Maltese ravioli filled with ricotta, egg, parsley and grated cheese, usually served with tomato sauce. USDA has no matching filled pasta; build from ingredients.
Aubergine, tomato, onion, capers and olives cooked in olive oil; the oil amount drives energy. Build from ingredients.
